zoomFactor.description: A value of 1 indicates tight framing. Less than 1 is a zoom-out. Greater than 1 is a zoom-in.

body.description: Rest of the JSON request document. Fields also set as top-level parameters replace the same keys here.

cameraName.description: If set, this camera is used to perform the render. The camera has to be defined in the scene.

extraOutputs.description: Request additional outputs from the renderer.

includeNodes.description: Nodes to be included into the matte, the list can contain glob patterns. If empty, the matte will contain all scene objects.

exportObjectIds.description: Export an image with one color per object.

groundPlane.description: Options related to the ground plane.

autoGroundScene.description: Automatically position the scene on the ground plane. Moves the scene along the vertical axis.

reflections.description: Enable/disable reflections onto the ground plane.

reflectionsOpacity.description: Controls the opacity of the reflections. Useful for compositing purposes.

reflectionsRoughness.description: Controls the roughness of the reflections. Useful for compositing purposes.

shadows.description: Controls whether the ground plane catches shadows or not.

shadowsOpacity.description: Controls the opacity of cast shadows. Only has effect if shadows are enabled.

baseFile.description: Define a scene from a file. If value is `null`, an empty scene will be created.

file.description: Path to the scene file in `sources`.

modelsRootNodeName.description: Define root node for models in scene graph. If not found, the node which is parent of all models in the scene will be used. If this node doesn't exist, a new node will be created under global root.

camera.description: Define a new camera for the scene.

transform.description: Controls the position and angle of the camera.

azimuthAltitude.description: Transform is defined by azimuth, altitude and radius terms. If set, do not set `matrix` or `trs`.

altitude.description: Altitude, in degrees, from -90 to 90 degrees.

azimuth.description: Rotation around the vertical axis, in degrees.

matrix.description: Transform is defined as a matrix. If set, do not set `trs` or `azimuthAltitude`.

trs.description: Transform is defined by translation, rotation and scale terms. If set, do not set `matrix` or `azimuthAltitude`.

environment.description: Define the environment for the scene. Override the previous existing environment.

file.description: Path to the environment file in `sources`. If the value is `null`, the first found environment file will be used.

preserveLights.description: A scene may contain 3D lights, like area lights or spot lights. By default, all those lights are removed when a new environment is set. Set this option to `true` to preserve the scene 3D lights.

rotation.description: Controls the orientation of the environment map.

formatOptions.description: define options specific for model file format

usd.description: options specific to USD file format

variant.description: name of the variant option to apply from the variant set

variantSet.description: name of the variant set to select from

variants.description: List of USD variants definition applied on USD primitives.

assignByDefault.description: Set to true to assign this material by default to all geometric primitives.

excludeFromDefault.description: List of nodes to exclude from default assignment.

preset.description: Select a preset to be used for the substance material rendering.

resolution.description: Substance material render resolution. This should be a power of two.

sbsar.description: Path to a substance material; if not set, the first substance 3D material found in sources will be used.

color.description: RGB color of the solid material, each component has to be in the [0,1] range.

metallicFactor.description: Metallic factor of the solid material, has to be in the [0,1] range.

roughnessFactor.description: Roughness factor of the solid material, has to be in the [0,1] range.

materialName.description: Desired material name, it will be sanitized to make a valid USD prim name.

nodeList.description: List of nodes under which geometric primitives will have this material assigned. Each entry can be a full node name or a glob expression.

materials.description: Assign new materials to geometric primitives.

metersPerUnit.description: Length of a scene unit, in meters. Defaults to `baseFile` meters per unit if any, or 0.01 (centimeters) otherwise.
